hook.text: Do you wake up with a sore throat? Skip the pharmacy.

tips.text: Gargle warm salt water for thirty seconds. The salt pulls fluid from swollen tissues and soothes the burning fast.
queries: glass of water on counter closeup

tips.text: Stir raw honey and lemon into hot water. Honey coats the throat while lemon supports your immune system.
Sip ginger tea slowly. Fresh ginger contains compounds that may help calm inflammation and ease the pain.

cta.text: Save this for the next time it hits.
